headline: High-speed train collision in Spain
event: A high-speed train collided with a stationary train south of Madrid, resulting in multiple fatalities.
context: The collision represents the second major railway accident in Spain during the current year.
scope: Rail passengers on the Madrid line and national transit operators are directly affected.

headline: Israeli general election yields impasse
event: Partial election results show Benjamin Netanyahu's coalition leading but remaining short of a legislative majority.
context: The vote follows a series of inconclusive national elections in Israel over recent years.
scope: Citizens of Israel and the 120 members of the Knesset are directly affected.

headline: Ebola outbreak surpasses ten thousand cases
event: Cumulative infections in the ongoing Ebola outbreak have exceeded 10,000 cases.
context: Public health agencies first declared the current disease outbreak in May.
scope: Populations in active transmission zones and regional medical infrastructure are directly affected.

headline: Flávio Bolsonaro enters United States
event: Flávio Bolsonaro arrived in Florida following an election loss and a Brazilian order to surrender his passport.
context: The departure occurred after Brazilian judicial authorities issued mandates regarding his travel documents.
scope: The Brazilian judicial system and diplomatic relations between Brazil and the United States are affected.

headline: Tanzania discovers new natural gas
event: Energy officials in Tanzania confirmed the discovery of a new natural gas deposit.
context: The event marks the country's first domestic natural gas discovery in more than ten years.
scope: The East African energy sector and Tanzanian domestic fuel consumers are directly affected.
